request: Explain the story, ideas, artistic highlights, and ending.

sources.title: The Yellow Wallpaper
sources.read_scope: web reader lines 24-485, continuous story text across two tool responses

story.statement: During rest arranged by her husband, she writes secretly and becomes preoccupied with wallpaper.

characters.statement: Her husband's dual role as spouse and doctor makes her objections difficult to acknowledge.

tone.statement: Everyday self-restraint gives way to disturbing perceptual certainty; this is not a simple recovery story.

ideas.statement: Care that denies experience is connected with the narrowing of expressive space.

highlights.statement: Wallpaper develops from decoration into an image of confinement; first person follows shifting perception.

ending.statement: The husband faints and she keeps creeping; reversed positions do not restore ordinary freedom.

quotes.text: I kept on creeping just the same, but I looked at him over my shoulder.

open_questions: Historical treatment context was not researched; no medical-history conclusion is asserted.
No published translation was compared; translated wording is not attributed to the author.
